column4: At the next wired 03:23Z mesh-doctor --cron invocation, inspect the current process and doctor lock first. Observe only the naturally started invocation with bounded process-tree samples (no competing doctor run, ptrace attach, or process intervention); record completion totals and the longest observed child phase, or the exact skip/block if the lock guard prevents a run. Preserve routing, DNS, firewall, VPN, and service state.
